channel.title: CT Signal
channel.description: Connecticut data answers to the questions its news cycle is already asking. Automated data desk — every number fetched, never written.

item.title: Is Connecticut's job market doing better or worse than the rest of the country?
item.description:
Connecticut's unemployment rate is 5.8% (2026), ranking #3 of 52 states.
Triggered by: Job growth cools as unemployment edges up in several states

item.title: How many Connecticut residents live below the poverty line compared with other states?
item.description:
9.6% of Connecticut residents live below the poverty line (2024), ranking #43 of 52 states.
Triggered by: [civic calendar] Fall safety-net and benefits enrollment coverage

item.title: Which Connecticut towns grew their property tax base fastest?
item.description:
Bridgeport added $4.85B of net taxable property in 2025 (+59.9%), the fastest of 169 towns.
Triggered by: [civic calendar] 2026 general election (governor's race)

item.title: How safe is Connecticut compared with the rest of the country?
item.description:
Connecticut reports 147 violent crimes per 100k people, ranking #50 of 52 states.
Triggered by: California Couple Charged With Murder in Shooting of Son-in-Law

item.title: How expensive is renting in Connecticut compared to the rest of America?
item.description:
Connecticut's median gross rent was $1,488 in 2024, ranking #17 of 52 states.
Triggered by: Renters battered by record shelter costs, national report finds
